headline: Colombia Maintains 35% Corporate Tax in Economic Rescue Law Adjustments
summary: Colombia's Ministry of Finance kept corporate income tax at 35% while proposing to raise import duties on hybrid and electric vehicles to 19%.
why: National tax reform legislation shapes corporate earnings metrics and foreign investment in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Maintained corporate tax rates provide policy stability while higher vehicle duties increase consumer costs.
